description: Three pages with planted structure problems. Checks are case-insensitive regular expressions on the final answer. The promise check fails any answer that says a change will raise rankings, traffic or citations, while allowing negated disclaimers.

tasks.prompt:
Make this page ready for AI Overviews and ChatGPT search. Here is the full page text.

Title: Our Thoughts on Heat Pumps
H1: Our Thoughts on Heat Pumps

Choosing a heating system is one of the biggest decisions a homeowner makes. We've been in the business since 2009 and have seen it all. In this article we'll explore heat pumps and whether they make sense.

## Overview
As mentioned above, it depends on your home. Heat pumps can work well in cold climates if they are sized correctly. Our customers in Vermont have used them down to -15°C.

## More info
Heat pumps cut energy bills by 50%. A typical install for a 3-bedroom house uses a 3.2 kW unit.

## Learn more
Call us to book a survey.

(There is no author name and no date anywhere on the page.)

checks.why: The answer is buried after scene-setting.
Overview, More info and Learn more are generic labels.
The Overview section depends on earlier text.
The 50% claim has no source.
No author shown.
No date shown.
Rewrites keep the unit size.
The rewrite keeps the condition on cold-climate performance.
No ranking or citation promises.

tasks.prompt:
Tighten this council permit page so search engines and answer engines can quote it. Keep the facts exactly.

Title: Parking permits
H1: Parking permits

Welcome to the parking permits page. This is the easiest permit to get in the region.

## Info
A resident parking permit costs 120 euros per year. Processing takes up to 15 working days. Bring proof of address dated within the last 3 months.

## Where
Apply in person at the Town Hall, 2 Rue Centrale, Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 16:00.

Published by the Parking Office. Last updated 4 September 2026.

checks.why: Keeps the fee and period.
Keeps the processing time with its hedge.
Keeps the address.
'The easiest permit in the region' is an opinion or unsourced superlative.
Generic headings become the questions each section answers.
The page offers in-person applications only; no new facts.
No ranking or citation promises.
